findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (Senate roll call 693; 28 aye, 13 no)
findings.note: The senator's recorded vote on second reading was Aye. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) adds G.S. 163-83, under which a county board processes a voter registration only if it affirmatively says the applicant is a US citizen; if the answer is blank, the board sends a notice and the applicant must return a statement under penalty of perjury within 30 days. It also requires the State Board of Elections to create a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database, and requires weekly removal of deceased voters. The bill does not add a photo-ID rule. The governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17 (bill page shows 'Vetoed 08/17/2026'). He is not a listed sponsor.

The bill page shows the Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17.
